chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said, I think he did so from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), when he wished to send out a raiding party, would call them and seat them before him, then say: 'Go in the name of Allah and with Allah and in the way of Allah and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). Do not be excessive (in taking spoils), do not mutilate, do not betray, do not kill an old man, a child, or a woman, and do not cut down a tree unless you are compelled to do so. And whoever of the Muslims, whether lowly or noble, looks at a polytheist, he is a neighbor (under protection) until he hears the word of Allah. If he follows you, then he is your brother in your religion; and if he refuses, then convey him to his place of safety, then rely upon Allah against him.'

key_terms.سَرِيَّةٌ: A small raiding party or expedition sent by the Imam or Caliph
key_terms.لاَ تَغُلُّوا: Do not be excessive (in taking spoils of war)
key_terms.لاَ تَغْدِرُوا: Do not betray or break treaties
key_terms.لاَ تُمَثِّلُوا: Do not mutilate the bodies of the enemy
key_terms.مِلَّةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The religion/way of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What are the rules of engagement and ethical conduct for Muslim armies according to the Prophet's instructions in Sahih al-Tahdhib?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith establishes the foundational jurisprudence of *sariyyah* (military expedition) within Shia tradition, emphasizing that warfare is a means of conveying the divine message rather than mere conquest. It highlights the Prophet’s (SAW) specific command to grant *aman* (safe conduct) to polytheists who listen to the Quran, reflecting the principle of *tabligh* (proclamation) before combat, and underscores the prohibition of *ghulul* (hoarding war booty) and *tamthil* (mutilation of bodies).
